claim: TubeArchivist cookie import makes liked videos and Watch Later accessible as regular subscribeable playlists
quote: Importing your YouTube Cookie into Tube Archivist allows yt-dlp to bypass age restrictions, gives access to private videos and your Watch Later or Liked Videos playlists.

claim: TubeArchivist is a self-hosted YouTube media server with 8.1k GitHub stars
quote: Subscribe to your favorite YouTube channels, Download Videos using yt-dlp, Index and make videos searchable, Play videos

claim: yt-dlp supports --cookies-from-browser and --download-archive for incremental playlist sync
quote: The name of the browser to load cookies from. Currently supported browsers are: brave, chrome, chromium, edge, firefox, opera, safari, vivaldi, whale.

claim: In 2026 Firefox is the only browser from which yt-dlp can extract YouTube cookies; Chrome 127+ uses app-bound encryption blocking external extraction
quote: Firefox doesn't encrypt cookies. Chrome 127+ introduced app-bound encryption that prevents external decryption, even with admin privileges.

claim: yt-dlp has a known partial-items bug with the liked videos playlist; closed unresolved as YouTube-side dynamic pagination issue
quote: [youtube:tab] Playlist Liked videos: Downloading 11 items of 11 — closed as cant-reproduce / site-bug

claim: Pinchflat supports cookies.txt upload for private playlist access including liked videos
quote: You set up rules for how to download content from YouTube channels or playlists and it'll do the rest, periodically checking for new content.

claim: Pinchflat has three cookie behaviors (Disabled, When Needed, All Operations) and warns that yt-dlp no longer recommends YouTube cookies due to IP ban risk
quote: yt-dlp no longer recommends using YouTube cookies since they can cause YouTube to issue IP bans. The project suggests avoiding this feature until the situation stabilizes.

claim: Syncify syncs YouTube playlists on a schedule via yt-dlp with optional cookies.txt support
quote: a tool for synchronising and fetching content from Spotify or YouTube playlists via yt-dlp

claim: ytdl-sub passes cookiefile through to yt-dlp for authenticated playlist downloads
quote: Pass any arg directly to yt-dlp's Python API

claim: TubeArchivist lets you subscribe to playlists including liked videos once cookie auth is set
quote: Subscribe to a playlist if the playlist contains videos from various channels, or if you only want to add a few playlists from a channel.

claim: ytm-yld downloads YouTube Music liked songs with OAuth auth and supports local sync (deletes removed tracks)
quote: a command-line utility able to get your all-time favourite songs from YouTube Music Your Likes playlist

claim: yt-dlp has had historical issues accessing private playlists even with cookies supplied
quote: Cannot access private playlist even when cookies are supplied

claim: yt-dlp --download-archive appends downloaded video IDs to a file and skips them on subsequent runs, enabling incremental sync
quote: you can use the --download-archive option to track which videos have already been downloaded and skip them on subsequent runs

claim: Running yt-dlp with --download-archive on a cron job is the standard pattern for automated playlist sync
quote: The --download-archive archive.txt flag appends each successfully downloaded video ID to a file, and on the next run, anything already in the archive is skipped

claim: TubeArchivist Companion browser extension (Firefox and Chrome) can import cookies directly into TubeArchivist
quote: allows users to download the video or subscribe to the channel directly from YouTube pages

claim: yt-dlp supports --cookies-from-browser for Firefox; cookies expire within approximately two weeks requiring manual refresh
quote: yt-dlp uses YouTube's InnerTube API internally, not the YouTube Data API v3 — completely different authentication systems
